company.name: Lightrun
company.shortDescription: Lightrun provides real-time application insights and dynamic instrumentation for developers.
company.description: Lightrun offers tools that enable developers to gain insights from live applications without interrupting their operations. The platform supports dynamic instrumentation, allowing users to add logs, metrics, and traces directly from their Integrated Development Environment (IDE). This capability simplifies the monitoring process in production environments, making it easier for teams to troubleshoot issues as they arise. Additionally, Lightrun features a GenAI model designed for runtime debugging, which automates the identification and resolution of problems in real-time. This approach enhances developer efficiency and streamlines the debugging process, providing valuable support for software development teams.
